# Repository Reconciliation
Confirmed reusable seams on canonical main:
- `runtime/interaction/.../selection_state.hpp` — existing SelectionState/SelectionSession semantics.
- `runtime/interaction/.../transform_session.hpp` — existing TransformSession + TransientSceneOverride.
- `runtime/render/.../frame_state.hpp` and `render_view_runtime.hpp` — per-view CameraGeneration / FrameState / RenderViewRuntime.
- `runtime/foundation/.../runtime_facade.hpp` — existing product-safe camera controls including panBy / zoomAt / fitToContent.
- existing EditorHistory, Debug UI/telemetry, Ink Playground and G4.5 Pen/Laser verification infrastructure remain reusable.
Known control-state finding:
- `.aegis/state.json` is stale and still describes the old G4 lifecycle state. It is generated cache, not Authority. G4.6 packages treat refresh/recomputation as control housekeeping and do not reopen G4.5.
# Frozen Targeted Amendments
## Snap Resolution Policy
- engage threshold: 6 logical view px.
- release threshold: 10 logical view px.
- X/Y resolved independently.
- features: min-edge / center / max-edge.
- selected/transformed objects excluded as target candidates.
- rotated geometry uses projected view-space extrema/center.
- deterministic tie-break: smallest correction → ObjectId bytewise order → target feature → source feature.
- active snap retains hysteresis until release threshold is exceeded.
- guides/highlights are transient; only final resolved transform may commit through existing TransformSession.
## Viewport Fit Policy
- fit padding: 32 logical px.
- baseline zoom clamp: 0.05x–32x unless repo reconciliation finds an already-accepted narrower runtime clamp; existing accepted clamp wins and must be recorded.
- empty target: reject without camera change.
- degenerate bounds: epsilon extent then max-zoom clamp.
- preserve current camera rotation.
- DPR changes physical pixels only; logical fit semantics remain unchanged.
## Physical Qualification
Physical qualification is frozen as a fixed scenario checklist, not an open-ended subjective review:
- selection chrome size/DPR crispness;
- mouse/touch/pen handle acquisition;
- move/resize/rotate/cancel continuity, no commit jump/stale chrome;
- slow/fast pan, wheel/pinch zoom, presets and fit;
- snap engage/release hysteresis and guide continuity;
- G4.5 Pen + Laser coexistence with editing overlay.
All blocking runs bind exact result revision, build identity, platform/device profile, scenario and exported evidence.
# Compressed P31 Packages
## GT-G4.6-A — Entry Reconciliation + Editing Presentation
Owns:
- per-view EditingOverlay foundation;
- Selection Chrome;
- Transform Handles;
- Undo/Redo/upstream regression preservation;
- diagnostics required by G4.6-C.
Key invariants:
- zero canonical/shared RuntimeScene mutation from overlay updates;
- screen-space/DPR-stable chrome with independent hit slop;
- zero canonical operations during transform drag;
- exactly one final SetTransforms on commit; zero on cancel.
Repo package: `.aegis/packages/GT-G4.6-A/package.json`.
Execution ref: `codex/g4-6-a-editing-presentation`.
## GT-G4.6-B — View / Constraint Presentation
Owns:
- ViewportController/equivalent using existing RuntimeFacade/FrameState seams;
- setZoom/setCenter/fit baseline;
- basic center/edge Snap/Guide;
- deterministic candidate policy/hysteresis;
- camera/overlay/candidate diagnostics.
Key invariants:
- camera-only changes do not mutate SemanticGeneration/shared RuntimeScene;
- zoomAt anchor stability;
- frozen Fit policy;
- scene/spatial query seam used instead of document-wide pointer-move scans.
Repo package: `.aegis/packages/GT-G4.6-B/package.json`.
Execution ref: `codex/g4-6-b-view-constraint`.
Predecessor: accepted GT-G4.6-A result must be in ancestry.
## GT-G4.6-C — Playground / Qualification / Downstream Workload Freeze
Owns:
- Canvas Interaction Playground 0.1;
- deterministic scenario selector/HUD/evidence export;
- Windows/Web/Android capability-profiled physical qualification;
- frozen interaction/presentation workload corpus for G4.7/G5;
- regression/qualification evidence return to independent Gate review.
Repo package: `.aegis/packages/GT-G4.6-C/package.json`.
Execution ref: `codex/g4-6-c-qualification`.
Predecessors: accepted A and B results must be in ancestry.
# Workload Frozen for G4.7 / G5
- select / deselect / multi-select
- handle hover
- move / resize / rotate
- move + snap guide
- slow / fast pan
- continuous zoom / zoom settle
- zoom-to-fit
- 100K + transform
- 100K + overlay
- 100K + G4.5 active ink / Laser coexistence
Required observations include scene generation delta, camera/view generation delta, overlay update count, transient transform count, candidate count, canonical operation count, invalidation/damage footprint, frame p50/p95/p99, CPU render/query observations and deterministic replay digest where applicable.
